The normalization under test is the one a downstream tool may apply on import: lowercase, keep a leading `--`, collapse every other run of dashes to one.

Scopes, codeSyntax presence, modes, pages and the text-style binding are complete, and every pair passes contrast (ink-900 on white is 17.5:1 in both modes), so no warning and no info.
The existing duplicate error on the bare name keeps its wording: var(--color-bg--surface) and --color-bg--surface are one name.
